missions.title: Back in the Gov
missions.desc: Sam and Max follow 3523 into the Government's hideout - and to Kyle.

lines.t: Whoa, this place is WAY bigger than our hideout!
When I worked here we didn't get anything. Who's funding you?
The Sky Rebellion. Without them we couldn't do any of this.
Shameful.
Sintrie. And you brought a Skylander. (He has karma now...)
At least WE aren't turning people into demons!
(...Sam.) He means it like a title.

reply.t: How's my Kyle Phone working? Everyone who tells you their real name... is mine.
Your 'captain' got his butt handed to him.

lines.t: Sintrie... that was my name. I won't forget it again.

missions.title: Training at F3
missions.desc: A week of training in the Gov hideout. 3523 is starting to warm up.

steps.obj: Spar with the Gov's training squad

lines.t: Soldier 3523... what's your actual name?
Nobody's ever asked me that. ...It's Hannah.
Hannah. Do you actually trust Kyle?
ALARM: Ultima spotted near hideout!
(I promised Rhalix I'd protect them.) Both of you - follow me!

missions.title: Psychotic Time Bomb
missions.desc: Ultima walks the halls of F3. Sam and Sintrie are in his way.

lines.t: Two Skylanders. Let me through and I won't kill you.
Years ago you blew up a facility. Know any of the names?
Only my sister's. Everyone else was a waste of space.
You don't care about ANY lives! Let's beat some heads!

steps.obj: Fight Ultima with Sam and Sintrie

escape_lines.t: Vampire Cut. That wound won't close while I keep it open.
Every part of my body is a weapon - and a shield. Your bombs went off inside me already.

lines.t: Hang on, Ultima. I can't have you killing my Sintrie just yet.
Kyle. I've been looking for you.
You want the data from the old facility. Fine - as partners.
(whisper) What are you doing, Kyle...

missions.title: The Corpse in the Pod
missions.desc: Kyle's project is finished. Sintrie knows the face.

lines.t: Look behind me, Sintrie. A blast from the past.
...Tech?
She wanted to grow old with you. Now she's an undead corpse - she never has to worry about dying.
Captain, go stop Ultima. I'll handle Tech.
I'm staying with the vice captain!

steps.obj: Survive Undead Technica (Sintrie won't fight back)

escape_lines.t: Your wings look like mine... You gave her MY DNA.
Die... die... Sintrie... make me die.

lines.t: Sam. Go check on the captain.
Vampire Cut. Your blood drains, you can't move. You won't hurt anyone else, Tech.
The ground starts to shake. Somewhere above, Mikiko is changing.
